metadata.description: A foundation that carries an intent to motion. The output is not a file — it is an event in a room. The boundary between the deterministic and the free is drawn at one typed value, the Motion Intent, and the machine reads it. Safety is a stage before the backend rather than an option, because the control box does not check the values it receives.

plugins.name: embodied-kinetic-loom
plugins.description: Embodied Kinetic Loom — carries an intent to motion. The unit is the Motion Intent: one typed value that the machine reads, and the line between what must be reproducible and what may vary is drawn at that type. Motion is not written to a file, so a plan is verified as a mechanism and never as an outcome. ⚠️ The sending side is built up to the serial port and stops there: the frames, the periodic loop, the run-time gate and a mock of the control box exist, and nothing opens a port. A green Mock does not guarantee the safety of the machine.
